title: Indahiro y'Umwana Utaravuka
intro: Umuntu w’umutima utaryarya yasezeranye isezerano ryera mbere y’uko umwana avuka. Inkuru y’uyu muntu igaragara mu nkuta z’urusengero, aho ubwitange buhabwa kwemerwa n’Imana. Uyu mugaragu wa Allah ni nde?
clues: Nari uwo mu muryango wubahwa muri Korowani.
Narahiye ko nzaha umwana wanjye utaravuka kugira ngo akorere Imana.
Ubwo nabyaraga, natunguwe no gusanga ari umukobwa, nubwo nari niteze umuhungu.
Nahaye umwana wanjye izina rya Mariyamu, izina rigaragaza ubwitange n'umurimo.
Nasabye Imana uburinzi bw'umwana wanjye n'abamukomokaho kuri Satani wavumwe.
Umwana wanjye yakiriwe n'Uwiteka maze ashyirwa mu maboko y'Umuhanuzi Zakariya mu rusengero.

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
